title: Digital Whistleblowing Platforms in Journalism: Encrypting Leaks
note: Author: Philip Di Salvo. Front matter (Acknowledgements) verified: 'Fabio "Naif" Pietrosanti and the Hermes Center for Transparency and Digital Human Rights ... have all been crucial' in making the book. Book landing page link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-030-38505-7 already known; this is the verifying front-matter PDF.

title: A Taxonomy of Whistleblowing Platforms (ch. 5 of Di Salvo, Digital Whistleblowing Platforms in Journalism)
note: Author: Philip Di Salvo. Chapter notes, n.1 cites Pietrosanti's Nexa talk slides 'https://nexa.polito.it/nexacenterfiles/mercoledi-73-pietrosanti.pdf'; n.3 says platform data were cross-checked with a member of the Hermes Center. Name appears only in the cited filename. Ch.3 'Whistleblowing Platforms' (..._3) discusses GlobaLeaks/Hermes Center but the public page shows no name.

title: This Machine Kills Secrets: How WikiLeakers, Cypherpunks and Hacktivists Aim to Free the World's Information
note: Author: Andy Greenberg. Second Internet Archive scan (the other copy thismachinekills0000gree is known). IA full-text verified: 'Fabio Pietrosanti and Arturo Filasto, the cofounders of GlobaLeaks, say they aim to create...'; 'Pietrosanti is a thirty-year-old security engineer'; index entry 'Pietrosanti, Fabio, 318-19'.

title: Profilo hacker. La scienza del criminal profiling applicata al mondo dell'hacking
note: Authors: Raoul Chiesa, Silvio Ciappi (ISBN 9788850325948; Google Books id BEvVGAAACAAJ). Italian original of 'Profiling Hackers' (CRC 2009, known: IA profilinghackers0000chie, where 'Fabio "Naif" Pietrosanti' is listed among acknowledged contributors). Italian edition NOT checked: Google Books blocked (API quota/bot check) and no full text found.

title: Aggiustare il mondo. La vita, il processo e l'eredità dell'hacker Aaron Swartz
note: Author: Giovanni Ziccardi. The IA full text describes Tor2web: 'Oggi Tor2web è parte del progetto GlobaLeaks, ed è mantenuto dal Centro Studi Hermes per la Trasparenza ed i Diritti Umani Digitali'. It never names Pietrosanti, so it is only indirect. Publisher assumed from memory, not checked.

outlet: The Tor Project (monthly status report, Nov 2011)
title: Tor Project monthly report, November 2011 ('New releases, new hires, new funding')
note: Under Outreach and Advocacy, verified: '1. Fabio Pietrosanti got Tor working on a WDTV', linking to a tor-dev post from Nov 2011. Mirrored on Internet Archive (manualzilla).

outlet: Defense Technical Information Center (DTIC ADA623038) / Tor Project tech report
title: Hidden-service Statistics Reported by Relays
note: Authors: G. Kadianakis, K. Loesing (Tor tech report 2015-04-001). Ref [12]: 'Virgil Griffith, Fabio Pietrosanti, and Giovanni Pellerano. Making tor2web mode faster'. The same text is known at research.torproject.org/techreports/hidden-service-stats-2015-04-28.pdf; this is the DTIC mirror. The IA compilation 'TorDevelopmentAndDesignPapers' has the same citation.

title: Il Gazzettino-Friuli 2020-10-02 (article on 'Open Rousseau')
note: IA full text verified: 'un gruppo di esperti informatici, Sviluppatori tra cui spicca il nome di Fabio Pietrosanti che oggi faranno debuttare ... "Open Rousseau". Un software libero ... basato sulla piattaforma Decidim'.

outlet: Ministero dell'Istruzione - Ufficio Scolastico Regionale per la Toscana
title: USR Toscana, decree on the bulk request for review (riesame) of FOIA / accesso civico generalizzato requests to 465 schools (prot. drto 16557 of 19.10.2022 and later)
note: IA full text verified: 'in data 19 settembre 2022 il sig. Fabio Pietrosanti ha inviato istanza di accesso civico generalizzato ... a tutte le 465 Istituzioni scolastiche della Regione Toscana'; the request for review is partly upheld. Name matches and fits his FOIA/transparency activism, but the document does not explicitly tie it to Hermes/GlobaLeaks.

title: Public money, public code, the Italian way: Hacking Italian Administrations to get to the code (in a legal way)
note: IA metadata: 'by Giovanni Battista Gallus and Fabio Pietrosanti (naif) At: FOSDEM 2018'. The YouTube original and FOSDEM page are known; this is an extra archival copy.

title: TorSNIP: Hidden Service Proxy with End-to-End Security
note: Author: Shoaib Kiyani. The OpenAlex full-text index matches 'Pietrosanti' together with 'Tor2web' and 'GlobaLeaks' (OpenAlex W2952741402). Repository refused connections, so the text was not opened.

title: La Stampa 1997-10-27 / 1997-10-30 / 1997-10-31 (list of names)
note: Recurring list in IA full text: '... Gabriella Giacoletto, Milano - Fabio Pietrosanti, Velletri (Roma) - Elio Romani, Malcesine (Vr)', apparently a prize or contest winners list. 'Velletri (Roma)' does not clearly match him (Latina); possible homonym. Kept for review only.
